summary: Interactive romantic Valentine web page (HTML/CSS/JS) with Yes/No choices where the No button evades hover clicks and a Yes click shows a celebratory meme/message; designed to run in Chrome on iPad.
architectural_notes: Build as a single-page static HTML/CSS/JS file intended to run locally in Chrome on iPad.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Meme-style romantic image with the words "Good choice" (valentine-good-choice-meme.dim_1024x1024.png)

existing_features.title: Create a single-page romantic Valentine prompt UI that asks: "Will you be my Valentine?" with exactly two prominent options: "Yes" and "No", using a pink-and-white romantic theme.

Implement interactive behavior for the "No" button so that when the user attempts to interact with it (mouse hover on desktop; touch/pointer interaction on iPad), it moves to a new position within the viewport/container, preventing the user from clicking it.
When the user clicks "Yes", transition the UI to a celebratory state that displays a meme image and the text: "Good choice".
Add the required static image asset(s) to the frontend and render them directly from the frontend (no backend routing), ensuring they load correctly in production builds.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a simple romantic-themed Valentine proposal page with Yes/No options
Make the 'No' button move away on hover so it cannot be clicked
On 'Yes' click, display a meme image/message saying 'Good choice'
Use a pink and white romantic color scheme and fully interactive UI (HTML/CSS/JS) compatible with iPad Chrome

projectName: Romantic Valentine proposal page with evasive No button and Yes celebration meme
